title.zh: 安全警报：X100正遭攻击，已损失约485万美元
title.en: 安全警报：X100正遭攻击，已损失约485万美元

current_state.zh: Blockaid 监测的 X100 治理攻击仍在进行：三名攻击者利用 Senate 席位控制，累计通过 3 笔交易套现约 485 万枚 USDT 并提取约 55 万枚 X，Freezer 中仍有约 1220 万枚 X 面临风险。
current_state.en: Blockaid's tracked X100 governance attack is ongoing: three attackers exploiting Senate seat control have extracted ~$4.85M in USDT plus ~550K X across three transactions, with ~12.2M X still held in Freezer at risk.

updates.title_zh: 安全警报：X100正遭攻击，已损失约485万美元
updates.title_en: 安全警报：X100正遭攻击，已损失约485万美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Blockaid披露以太坊项目X100正遭受攻击，攻击者夺取了3个参议院席位中的2个，并将40万枚X代币抛入其自建的空流动性池；另一名攻击者摧毁了Freezer的Uniswap V3流动性头寸，在两笔交易中净获约485万美元USDT，攻击仍在进行中。
updates.what_changed_en: Blockaid disclosed an active attack on Ethereum project X100 in which an attacker captured 2 of 3 Senate seats and dumped 400,000 X tokens into a self-created empty-liquidity pool, while a second attacker destroyed Freezer's Uniswap V3 liquidity position, netting roughly $4.85M in USDT across two transactions with the attack still underway.
